:::{#def-ldpc-code}
#### Regular low-density parity-check code

Let $j, k \ge 1$ be [integers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers).
A **$(j, k)$-regular LDPC code** (low-density parity-check code) <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
is a [linear code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-linear-code) over $\ffield{2}$
that has a [parity-check matrix](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-linear-code) with $j$ ones in every column
and $k$ ones in every row, and zeros elsewhere.
Gallager introduced these codes [@gallager1962low].

:::
